implementationNotes: Only Uncap was approved for removal. Other removal candidates remain listed.
FOMO uses a standard DeFi app profile; its description states that STRK can be traded on FOMO.
Privily is a Starknet L3, not a Starknet L2 mainnet app.
Omnisea, Sats Terminal, NUMS, Abyss and Midgard remain pending verification and were not added.
Original profile and directory layouts retained. No new labels or categories.
FOMO, Privily and Zylith use standard profiles with false L2 live flags; scope and availability are explained in descriptions.
